entities.title: Tool skills
entities.summary: One SKILL.md per tool, telling a coding agent when and how to use it: zazzle, zazz scripts, agent-fs, fix-network, free-disk-space and cyberspace-generator.
entities.purpose: Each subfolder is one skill, named after its directory, with frontmatter an agent matches a task against and short imperative steps. AGENTS.md lists them.
boundaries: A skill wraps its tool's binary; what the tool does is documented in the tool's own folder (zazz scripts: zazzled's src/zazz).
zazzle-csharp-indexer has no skill here: zazzle-csharp-indexer init prints its own snippet for AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
